original_test_intent: Verify every expected PVDD11_S3_P0 through PN _C sensor is mapped to the correct rail/device and reports human-readable current, status and thresholds matching the approved electrical specification.
original_method: Resolve the PVDD11, S3, P-index and C semantics, enumerate all expected rail-current channels and immutable raw/UI identities, collect complete value/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized associated voltage, power, VR/device health, load and temperature context, and compare each result to the owner contract without changing electrical state.
manual_activity: The owner defines the rail and suffix semantics, P-index topology, current scaling/limits and electrical context; an operator verifies raw/UI readability and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: PVDD11/S3/P0..PN/C definition and physical rail/device to SDR/Redfish/UI mapping
Current unit/scale, normal range, warning/critical thresholds and sampling specification
Read-only associated voltage, power, load, VR/device health and temperature context
UI refresh/rounding tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never change rail voltage/current limit, load, VR settings, sequencing, thresholds or power policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind every reading to its physical rail/device and synchronized electrical context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on overcurrent/undercurrent alarm, rail/VR fault, impossible unit/value, missing/duplicate mapping or BMC error
Do not retry after applying load or changing electrical state
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify the complete PVDD11 S3 P-series current population and mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with read-only electrical context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/scale normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, mapping or raw/UI/context/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no electrical stimulus or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define PVDD11/S3/P/C semantics and supply authoritative rail map and current limits
Review rail/VR health, electrical plausibility and raw/UI discrepancies

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL PACKAGE-GATED PVDD11 S3 RAIL-CURRENT VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-P-index matrix containing rail/VR/device identity and C meaning, raw current/unit/status/threshold, associated voltage/power/load/health/thermal context and UI display, with completeness and specification results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds vendor rail semantics and electrical plausibility while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and any load manipulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One current-like value cannot prove suffix semantics or cover P0..PN. Every expected mapped rail channel and threshold must be reconciled.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM rail names may encode power state, device island or measurement phase, and C may not universally mean amperes; generic current assumptions can create unsafe false verdicts.

PVDD11/S3/P/C definition and per-channel rail/VR/device to raw/UI identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved scale/sampling/plausibility comparison
Per-channel discrepancies, no-stimulus/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently request PVDD11 S3 P-series sensor validation. Vendor rail and suffix semantics are missing project inputs, not contradictory source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Rail semantics/mapping, electrical specification and complete raw/UI/context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Prevents a vendor suffix from being assumed to mean current and requires complete per-rail identity plus passive electrical plausibility evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The label encodes several platform-local dimensions: PVDD11, S3, a P index and suffix C. None should be expanded without the board specification. Even when C denotes current, a plausible value depends on associated voltage, power state, load and VR health. The review therefore gates interpretation on an explicit rail map and checks passive correlated evidence, while prohibiting stimulus because an unintended rail or power-sequence change has broad hardware risk.
